def M1_S5_IdempotentReplay():
    # D6.5: After a duplicate commit delivery, the shard state must not change.
    # Snapshot before duplicate is taken in DuplicateCommit0/1 actions.
    if duplicate_commit_delivered:
        # The persisted epoch must equal the snapshot taken before the dup
        # (i.e. the duplicate had no effect on shard state).
        return (persisted_epoch_0 == snapshot_epoch_0_before_dup and
                persisted_epoch_1 == snapshot_epoch_1_before_dup)
    return True
